subject: Request: Supplemental promo credits and trial extension for Greenfield CLab pilot
messages:
From: Dr. Amira Hasan <a.hasan@greenfield.edu>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine@redwood.com>
Cc: grants@greenfield.edu
Date: Wed, 17 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: supplemental promo credits and trial extension for CLab summer pilot

Hi Jasmine,

Thanks for the prior promo credits — the students are excited. We hit an unexpected delay with our IRB amendment (new consent language) and that pushed our annotated dataset collection window into July. The current trial credit expires 6/30 and we will likely exhaust what remains before we can complete the evaluation set.

Could Redwood consider a small supplemental credit allocation (roughly equivalent to an extra month of usage at our current consumption rates) or a short trial extension so we can finish the evaluation and submit the pilot report? This pilot is for non-commercial research (Greenfield Univ CLab) and will be used to evaluate model behavior on low-resource morphosyntax tasks; results will be shared with Redwood in a short findings memo.

Attached: IRB_approval_scanned.pdf (pdf) and our updated pilot_plan_v2.docx (docx).

If useful I can provide a brief usage estimate and an internal letter confirming non-commercial scope. We really appreciate any help — the students’ capstone depends on this timing.

Best,
Amira Hasan
Associate Professor, Computational Linguistics
Greenfield University

Jasmine — thanks for the loop. I reviewed the IRB and the pilot plan; Greenfield CLab looks like a standard eligible academic research use. Given the timeline sensitivity and that this is non-commercial university research, I approve a one-time supplemental credit allocation equivalent to four weeks at their current average consumption.

Terms:
- Credits will be applied to the account used for the current trial. Please confirm the account email (Amira, cc’d).
- Credits expire 90 days after issuance.
- The allocation is a promotional goodwill grant and not recurring; if usage exceeds the promo we can discuss a discounted committed plan.

Action items for Jasmine: please confirm the account email and send the DocuSign acceptance link to Amira. I’m happy to authorize the DocuSign template DEV-SCHOLARSHIP-2026 for this. Monica — loop you in for bookkeeping and HubSpot deal update.

Ben Carter
